summary: 13 years of Human Resources experience and 27 years of administrative experience working in various settings. Professional, detail-oriented, excellent time-management skills, team player, open and honest communicator, effective at maintaining confidentiality and multi-tasker.

experience.title: HR Benefits/Leave Coordinator
responsibilities: Provide consultation and assistance for all employee benefits.
Assist Retirement/Benefits Manager in counseling employees on retirements and generating retirement calculations.
Assist with retirement trainings.
Promote and coordinate the Highlander Wellness Watch program.
Advise faculty/staff on leave policies and procedures.
Interpret and apply policies, procedures and guidelines.
Develop and present leave trainings for employees and supervisors.
Content editor for the HR newsletter and HR website committee.
Analyze and reconcile leave discrepancies.
Process and maintain Workers Compensation claims, short term disability claims and FMLA requests.
Coordinate return to work for employees on short term disability, FMLA and WC.
Maintain OSHA logs and reporting (OSHA 301 and OSHA 300A).
Process employees leave corrections and share requests, coordinate payments with payroll.
Calculate leave payouts for separating employees.
Process reports in Banner (HRIS) to ensure compliance with FLSA regulations.
Perform leave audits.
Provide programmatic support for the online leave reporting system.
Assist with other HR duties such as job fairs, benefits fairs, and other events.
Maintain confidential and sensitive information.
